E1.evidence: Issue rmw_cyclonedds#279 (by maintainer clalancette) gives the failing CI test, a full stack trace ending in `__GI_abort ()` from `sertype_rmw_realloc_samples` (serdata.cpp:458), and a root-cause analysis; eboasson (Cyclone DDS) and clalancette confirm and fix it in rmw_implementation#175.

E2.evidence: The test (package test_rmw_implementation) calls `rmw_take_sequence()` implemented by rmw_cyclonedds_cpp with a message sequence that was initialized by `rmw_message_sequence_init()` but whose element pointers were never set. rmw_cyclonedds_cpp passes that array to Cyclone DDS `dds_take`, which allocates when `buf[0] == NULL`, and rmw_cyclonedds_cpp's realloc callback aborts. The documented precondition of rmw_take_sequence requires the sequence to be "populated with ROS messages whose type matches the message type support registered with the `subscription` on creation." The failure depends on the argument crossing the API boundary (a caller that populates the sequence does not trigger it); the resolving change is in the caller's code, not in deployment wiring or build configuration.

E3.evidence: PAIR: an output of the test (the message_sequence argument) feeds an input of rmw_cyclonedds_cpp's rmw_take_sequence (stack frames #9 -> #8 -> #7 -> #6 in the issue).

E4.evidence: Observed failure: occasional CI failures of test_subscription__rmw_cyclonedds_cpp::take_sequence, with the captured abort stack trace in the issue body.

failed_conditions.quote:
As it stands, the take_sequence test fulfills the first part of that
(it was initialized by rmw_message_sequence_init()), but doesn't fulfill
the second part (populated by ROS messages).  In certain situations,
this could lead to an aborted test later on.

loudness_evidence:
The failure is a runtime abort inside the call, found only as an intermittent CI failure: "#1  0x0000ffff81ca9d68 in __GI_abort () at abort.c:79
#2  0x0000ffff81af782c in sertype_rmw_realloc_samples (ptrs=0xaaaaca346c10, d=0xaaaaca027250, old=0x0, oldcount=0, count=1)" (https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/issues/279). No build, connection, or activation diagnostic flags the unpopulated sequence; the reporter notes "In most cases, the sequence of bytes stored in that pointer is *not* zero, so we never end up trying to call `ddsi_sertype_realloc_samples` (and hence we don't `abort()`)."

resolution.summary: The test populates the sequence after rmw_message_sequence_init() (sets each `sequence.data[ii]` to an element of a test_msgs Strings sequence) before calling rmw_take_sequence (rmw_implementation#175, ef0fcda0).
resolution.evidence: clalancette: "So I think that between the fix to rmw_cyclonedds and the fix to test_rmw_implementation, we can consider this issue fixed." (https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/issues/279#issuecomment-772621695); eboasson later withdrew the rmw_cyclonedds change: "the sequence of messages passed in actually conforms to what Cyclone DDS expects (an initialised array of pointers to messages), and https://github.com/ros2/rmw_implementation/pull/175 seems to clarify that." (https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/pull/280#issuecomment-1185252159); issue closed "as we fixed it years ago." (https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/issues/279#issuecomment-1589917827). The source does not show the resolved composition running the test without the abort (the failure was intermittent).

notes: Class `other`: the consumer violates a documented call precondition of rmw_take_sequence (argument state), which fits none of the type, frame, unit, QoS, or encoding classes. Calls pass through the rmw_implementation dispatch library (frame #8, rmw_implementation/src/functions.cpp) into rmw_cyclonedds_cpp, and rmw_cyclonedds_cpp then calls Cyclone DDS (eclipse-cyclonedds, revision not stated). A second composition was discussed: rmw_cyclonedds_cpp -> Cyclone DDS `dds_take` (the `buf[0] == NULL` allocation convention and rmw_cyclonedds_cpp's abort() in the sertype realloc callback); eboasson first called a type confusion there "the real bug" and proposed rmw_cyclonedds#280, then withdrew it as "a non-existent problem"; it is not part of this case. The packet's fix ref rmw_cyclonedds#408 ("Improve error message when create_topic fails (backport #405)", foxy, 2022) is unrelated to the fix: it cross-references #279 only because eboasson cites it as a flaky test (https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/pull/408#issuecomment-1231161848). Observation: the fixture's subscription uses `ROSIDL_GET_MSG_TYPE_SUPPORT(test_msgs, msg, BasicTypes)` while the fix populates the sequence with test_msgs Strings elements; the test expects `taken == 0`, so no sample is deserialized into them. clalancette did not add a test for the NULL-pointer case: "I didn't add the `nullptr` test because all of the RMWs seem to have the same problem."
